runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_count FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_address_business_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_address_business_count
FROM biz_addr ba
JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS home_address_business_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN ba.ref1 END) AS shipping_address_business_count
FROM biz_addr ba
JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref2 = at.addr_typ_id
WHERE at.nm IN ('Home', 'Shipping')
